summary.text: Shawn Stevens is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 61 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Vince McGrail.
He previously served in the Ohio House of Representatives, representing District 68 in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Shawn Stevens assumed office in the Ohio House on March 9, 2022, succeeding Rick Carfagna in District 68, and left office on December 31, 2022.
He ran for District 61 in the August 2, 2022 Republican primary and lost to Beth Lear, 58.1 percent to 41.9 percent.
Stevens advanced from the Republican primary for District 61 on May 5, 2026.
